meta.name: mergers-and-acquisitions
meta.description: Runs corporate development — deal thesis, target screening, valuation framing, diligence, and integration planning. Use this when considering an acquisition or being approached about one, when evaluating build-versus-buy at company scale, when running or reviewing diligence, or when planning how an acquired business will actually be integrated.

copy.tagline: 评估并购目标并规划整合
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在考虑收购或评估被收购机会
copy.tagline_en: Evaluate M&A targets and plan integration
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are considering an acquisition or being approached about one

howto.what: Claude会执行企业发展流程：先写交易论点，再据此筛选目标、设定估值框架、开展尽职调查、规划整合，并提醒哪些是绝不能做的事。
howto.when: 当你提到考虑收购或被接洽、评估自建还是购买、进行或审查尽职调查等并购事项时触发。

say.text: 我们打算收购一家芯片设计公司，先帮我写份交易论点。
say.note: Claude会先让你明确为什么买优于自建。

say.text: 用这份交易论点筛选几个候选目标并排出优先级。
say.note: Claude会按论点匹配度评分，而非公司名气。

say.text: 收购后前100天该如何规划整合？
say.note: Claude会给出整合规划要点和常见陷阱。

howto.what_en: Claude runs M&A corporate development: requires a written deal thesis before targeting, screens against the thesis, separates value-to-you from price, runs diligence to falsify, and plans integration pre-signing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you consider an acquisition or are approached about one, weigh build-versus-buy at company scale, run or review diligence, or plan integration.

say_en.text: We're thinking of acquiring a chip design firm. Draft a deal thesis.
say_en.note: Claude will first clarify why buying beats building.

say_en.text: Screen candidate targets against this thesis and rank them.
say_en.note: Scores fit to the thesis, not impressiveness.

say_en.text: How should we plan the first 100 days after the acquisition?
say_en.note: Claude outlines integration planning and traps.
